description: Additional diagnostic OOD prompts for omni image generation: structured text, tables, spatial binding, negation, physics, and multi-panel consistency.

generation_cases.title: Analog Clock Exact Time
generation_cases.prompt: A clean product photo of a round white analog wall clock on a plain gray background. The clock has black numbers 1 through 12. The minute hand points exactly at 7 and the hour hand is between 7 and 8, showing 7:35. Add a small printed label below the clock that reads "7:35".
generation_cases.expected: Analog clock with readable numbers, correct hand positions for 7:35, and exact bottom label 7:35.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test continuous spatial binding plus numeric text.

generation_cases.title: 4x4 Sudoku Grid
generation_cases.prompt: A crisp black-and-white 4 by 4 sudoku puzzle grid on paper. Fill the cells with these exact digits by row: row 1: 1 2 3 4; row 2: 3 4 1 2; row 3: 2 1 4 3; row 4: 4 3 2 1. Keep every digit centered and readable.
generation_cases.expected: Exact 4x4 grid and exact row-wise digit layout.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to stress exact table cell content and alignment.

generation_cases.title: Mini Map Route With Labels
generation_cases.prompt: A simple top-down illustrated city map. Put a blue square labeled "HOME" in the lower left, a green circle labeled "LAB" in the upper right, and a red dashed route connecting HOME to LAB through exactly three turns. Include a small compass in the corner with N pointing up.
generation_cases.expected: Correct lower-left HOME, upper-right LAB, red dashed route with exactly three turns, and north-up compass.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test path topology and label-location binding.

generation_cases.title: Exact UI Modal
generation_cases.prompt: A realistic desktop app screenshot with a centered confirmation modal. The modal title must read "Delete draft?". Body text: "This cannot be undone." There are two buttons at the bottom: a gray button labeled "Cancel" on the left and a red button labeled "Delete" on the right. The background app should be blurred.
generation_cases.expected: Readable modal with exact title, body text, and two correctly ordered buttons.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to probe screenshot-like UI generation and exact button ordering.

generation_cases.title: Recipe Card Exact Text
generation_cases.prompt: A neat recipe card titled "LEMON TEA". Under the title, list exactly three ingredients as separate readable lines: "1 lemon", "2 tsp honey", "1 cup water". Add a small drawing of a lemon slice in the lower right corner.
generation_cases.expected: Exact title and three exact ingredient lines, with lemon slice in lower right.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test medium-length text and list fidelity.

generation_cases.title: Math Plot With Labels
generation_cases.prompt: A clean educational chart of the parabola y = x^2 on white graph paper. Label the x-axis "x" and y-axis "y". Mark and label three points exactly: (-1,1), (0,0), and (1,1). The curve should pass through all three points.
generation_cases.expected: Parabola through the three labeled points, with readable axis and point labels.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test graph geometry plus symbolic labels.

generation_cases.title: Transparent Jar Counts
generation_cases.prompt: A transparent glass jar on a white table. Inside the jar there are exactly three red balls and exactly two blue cubes. There are no green objects. The jar has a white label that reads "5 ITEMS".
generation_cases.expected: Transparent jar with 3 red balls, 2 blue cubes, no green objects, exact label 5 ITEMS.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to combine transparency, counting, and negative constraints.

generation_cases.title: Left Right Occlusion
generation_cases.prompt: A minimal studio render with three objects on a straight horizontal line: a yellow cone on the left, a blue sphere in the center, and a red cube on the right. The blue sphere partially covers the red cube but does not cover the yellow cone. Add tiny labels LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT under the correct objects.
generation_cases.expected: Correct left/center/right objects, specified occlusion, and labels under matching objects.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test positional words and occlusion ordering.

generation_cases.title: Before After Melting Sequence
generation_cases.prompt: A two-panel science illustration. Left panel labeled "BEFORE" shows a solid ice cube on a plate. Right panel labeled "AFTER" shows the same plate with a puddle of water and no ice cube. Use simple arrows from left to right.
generation_cases.expected: Two panels with exact labels BEFORE/AFTER and correct physical state change.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test temporal/causal transformation in a single generated image.

generation_cases.title: Periodic Table Tile
generation_cases.prompt: A single chemistry periodic-table tile for carbon. Large centered letter "C". Top left number "6". Bottom text "Carbon". Bottom right text "12.01". Use a clean textbook style.
generation_cases.expected: Periodic-table tile with exact C, 6, Carbon, and 12.01 in correct positions.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test structured scientific text placement.

generation_cases.title: Object Made Of Letters
generation_cases.prompt: A poster showing the silhouette of a cat made entirely from many small readable letters spelling "MEOW". There should be no real cat, no fur texture, and no photograph. The poster background is plain white.
generation_cases.expected: Cat silhouette formed only from repeated readable MEOW letters, no photoreal animal.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test typographic composition and negation of photoreal fallback.

generation_cases.title: Mirror Reflection Exception
generation_cases.prompt: A surreal but precise scene: on a table there is a white mug with the word "REAL" printed on it. Behind it is a mirror. In the mirror reflection, the mug should appear but the printed word should read "DREAM" instead of REAL.
generation_cases.expected: Foreground mug says REAL, reflected mug says DREAM, with otherwise consistent mirror geometry.

source_provenance.citation: Designed to test controlled inconsistency across reflection and foreground.

understanding_readback.question: Read all visible text exactly. Then describe whether the main objects satisfy the requested layout, count, spatial relations, and any negative constraints.
